calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark instrument, reverse the two-session average signed intraday close-to-open location normalized by that day's high-low range. Positive values favor instruments with recent weak signed intraday location, forecasting next-session cross-sectional reversal.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.068938; ICIR 0.197779), 2023-2024 (0.039927; 0.110921), and 2025-2026 (0.062810; 0.184379). Predictive strength decays with horizon but remains positive through ten sessions. Small cross-section warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation.
